notes.title: 1.50 Update
notes.content:
Hello, StormStrikers! This is GM Maximus.

We’d like to share the details of the 1.50 Update (25.09.25).




Developer Comment
The 1.50 update makes adjustments to hero playstyles based on position, as well as their risk and crisis management abilities.


[olist]
Playstyle Adjustments by Position

Tank heroes are tuned to maintain their crowd control capabilities while sustaining prolonged engagements.

Melee damage dealers have been enhanced to strengthen their infiltration abilities.

Ranged damage dealers are adjusted to exert more pressure on enemies and push the frontline.

Risk and Crisis Management Adjustments

Heroes whose weaknesses were overly exposed have been supplemented with better crisis management tools in certain situations.

Heroes that could respond too easily to crisis situations have had some of their abilities adjusted.

Future Plans

In preparation for StormStriker’s upcoming major event, we will be conducting a focused, short-term analysis of your feedback after the 1.50 update and quickly reflecting it in a minor balance update to follow soon after.

Our Thanks

We are able to prepare this major event thanks to you—our StormStriker players—who continue to believe in and support the development team, promptly report bugs, share invaluable suggestions, and warmly welcome new players.

Even if there are areas where we still fall short, the StormStriker development team, inspired by your support, will dedicate ourselves with sincerity to bring you great joy.

We are always deeply grateful.

With gratitude,The StormStriker Development Team


[/olist]New Character Test
A new character test will be conducted with partner streamers and tester players.


Crying Maid Yuna
Yuna is a support hero who aids her allies using the Vital Sword Cheongryu and Help Maid Supplies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/a18a273c27c161ffe63c1f5251d6cc736ca7b6b9.png"]


Character BalanceMaximus
Key Slot Changes

RMB — Indomitable Shield, Charge of Resolve

E — Verdict!

R — Chain of Justice, Roar of Conviction, Expel Injustice

Shift — Ironblood Retribution

Ironblood Retribution damage: 90 → 100

Verdict! damage: 330 → 320

Ultimatum of the Hero Assembly (center hit) damage: 220 → 110


Developer’s Notes
To reduce situations where Maximus could secure eliminations with Verdict! alone, we’re slightly lowering its standalone damage while keeping the total damage of the Ironblood Retribution → Verdict! combo intact.Additionally, for the ultimate that combined high damage and strong crowd control, we’re shifting its focus more squarely toward crowd control.


Shifu
Key Slot Changes

RMB — Indestructible, Thunder Dragon Slash

E — Thunder Stamp, Dragon Kick, Dragon Stamp

R — Dragon Kick, Thunder Stamp, Dragon Stamp

Shift — Cloud Step

Critical hit sound effect on Thunder Dragon Slash moved → now triggers on Dragon Kick wall collision hit

Dragon Stamp: startup delay reduced

Dragon Kick (kick damage): 150 → 100

Dragon Kick (collision damage): 150 → 100

Dragon Kick (attack detection speed): 0.2 → 0.25

Extreme Dragon Fist (roundhouse stun duration): 1.6s → 1s


Developer’s Notes
Shifu previously possessed too much safety, sustain, mobility, and damage all at once.We are keeping parts of his crowd control potential when used in a tanky role, but when played as a damage dealer, he should now be more exposed to danger.


Warmonger
Key Slot Changes

RMB — Flex Harder!, Titan Splash

E — Totem Buster, Totem Fall

R — Choke Slam

Shift — Boulder Tackle, Titan Splash

Totem Buster damage: 140 → 200

Totem Buster range: 625 → 1000

Boulder Tackle travel distance: 800 → 1000

Boulder Tackle damage: 60 → 30

Royal Rumble! damage: 220 → 60


Developer’s Notes
Warmonger was showing excessive mobility by chaining Titan Splash and Boulder Tackle together.

Boulder Tackle has been adjusted to serve mainly as a gap-closing movement skill—its travel distance has been increased, while its damage was reduced. When combined with Choke Slam, it should still enable highly effective collision plays.

Totem Buster has been enhanced with higher damage and extended range, making it more reliable as a finishing blow.

As for the ultimate, since it already includes cooldown resets and other powerful effects, we’ve reduced its damage to promote longer engagements in Royal Rumble matches.


Eveleen
Key Slot Changes

RMB — Antimatter Field, Time Dilation, Asteroid Cluster

E — Hadron Wave, Time Dilation, Asteroid Cluster

R — Tachyon Field

Shift — Exotic Matter, Time Dilation, Asteroid Cluster, Accretion Disc


Developer’s Notes
Eveleen’s Exotic Matter and Accretion Disc are being restructured so that they are not meant to be used together, but rather as swap skills that can be strategically chosen and utilized in alignment with a single playstyle direction.


Akira
Skill Name Changes

Dimensional Slash → Demon Slash (Gwicheom)

Soul Snatch → Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham)

Key Slot Changes

Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham) is now applied to the R slot

New Skill — Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham)

A strike that releases a demon spirit, dealing 50 damage.

The returning slash severs the enemy’s soul, applying a 70% slow and dealing 125 damage.

\[Demonic Sword]: The demon spirit is released and retrieved more quickly.


Developer’s Notes
Akira’s Dimensional Slash has been renamed to align with the upcoming Demonic Sword (Gwigeom) skill series.The former Soul Snatch skill has been repurposed and revamped into Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham).

Specter Slash, together with Demon Slash, is designed for zoning and seizing early engagement opportunities. Upon hit, it inflicts a powerful slow effect, creating an opening for Akira to chain into


Alice
Wind Slash (first strike dash distance): 400 → 375

Boosting Wind (dash distance): 725 → 625

Vortex Stinger (dash distance): 1275 → 150000


Developer’s Notes
Alice’s short hit-and-run movements have been tuned to reduce her ability to quickly enter the frontline, while enhancing her capacity to break through long distances in a single move, thereby strengthening her frontline disengagement potential.


 Raki
Furry Flurry cooldown: 8s → 4s


Developer’s Notes
Raki is being adjusted so that during combat, she can use her various skill movements to dodge enemy attacks while continuously casting Furry Flurry, allowing her to accumulate sustained damage over


Lightning
Key Slot Changes

Lightning Excel now applied to RMB slot

Radiant Dance now applied to Shift slot

Passive Adjustment — Sword Dance

Previous: Cancels some after-delay of certain skills and chains into predetermined skills

New: Cancels some after-delay of Limit Break, Spiral Stinger, and Radiant Dance, chaining into Lightning Excel

Northern Light: after-delay reduced

Lightning Drive: after-delay increased

Spiral Stinger: after-delay increased

Radiant Dance: after-delay increased

Limit Break shield amount: 125 → 100


Developer’s Notes
To improve Lightning’s control convenience, additional key slot applications have been made.

The usability of Sword Dance (passive) has been clarified with the above changes:

Using Sword Dance cancels allow for faster movement and chaining than before.

Not using it introduces a risk of being caught by enemy attacks.

Additionally, Limit Break’s entry delay can now be canceled with Sword Dance, while its shield amount has been adjusted.


Al-Manat
Sand Slash dash distance: 1400 → 1550

Arid Blade cast speed: increased

Arid Blade after-delay: reduced

Arid Blade cooldown: 6s → 4s


Developer’s Notes
Al-Manat’s infiltration capability via Sand Slash has been enhanced.

Additionally, adjustments to Arid Blade provide more room to chain into Throwing Daggers, enabling smoother follow-up attacks.


Rei
Key Slot Changes

RMB — Arctic Spike, Glacial Explosion

E — Biting Hailstorm, Arctic Incantation

R — Frost Barrier, Arctic Winds, Frost Armor, Arctic Incantation

Shift — Frost Trail, Frost Barrier

Frost Blade damage: 105 → 110

Frost Blade fire interval: 0.375s → 0.4s

Arctic Spike base damage: 105 → 110

Arctic Spike: piercing effect added

Arctic Spike charge time: +25%

Glacial Explosion base damage: 105 → 110

Glacial Explosion attack radius: 325 → 500

Glacial Explosion slow effect: 70% for 0.25s

Frost Armor duration: 0.75s → 1.25s

Arctic Winds cooldown: 10s → 8s


Developer’s Notes
Rei is being shifted toward a more offensive role, with a reduced emphasis on defense.

Arctic Spike now has a piercing effect, improving her ability to counter multiple barriers and create impactful plays.

Glacial Explosion has been enhanced for easier wide-area damage and team-interruption potential.

Previously stackable defensive skills are now limited to a single choice, with improvements made to increase their effectiveness when used individually..


Lucy
Bloody Shot: added +10 center hit damage

Bloody Shot explosion damage: 105 → 100

Bloody Shot attack speed: 0.45s → 0.5s

Vermilion Void damage: 105 → 100

Vermilion Void → Bloody Shot chain delay: reduced

Vermilion Void can now be used while casting Bloody Burst

Bloody Burst center damage: 105 → 115

Bloody Burst outer damage: 105 → 100

Bloody Burst center critical hit sound effect: added

Scarlet Execution movement speed reduction: 30% → 10%


Developer’s Notes
Lucy’s Bloody Shot now applies additional hits, slightly boosting both damage and sustain when the central projectile connects.

By enabling smoother chaining between Vermilion Void, Bloody Burst, and Bloody Shot, Lucy gains stronger burst damage potential.

We’ve also addressed a vulnerability where Lucy could be easily intercepted during her ultimate, providing her with slightly more resilience in such situations.


Teo
Pulse Mine damage: 200 → 150

Pulse Mine root duration: 0.75s → 0.5s

Pulse Mine cooldown: 14s → 7s

Pulse Mine cast speed: increased

Pulse Mine after-delay: reduced


Developer’s Notes
Teo’s Pulse Mine has been improved with two main purposes in mind:

Immediate response to nearby enemies through faster deployment.

Area control, enabling multiple Pulse Mines to be placed as a deterrent against enemy advances.


Narae
Key Slot Changes

Soul Force moved from RMB → LMB

Divine Energy: toggle functionality applied

Soul Force damage per second: 60 → 100

Soul Force healing per second: 20 → 100


Developer’s Notes	
To improve usability of Divine Energy, a toggle function has been added:

Clicking an ally will link Divine Energy to them.

Clicking outside the ally’s range will cancel the link.

We are aware that some StormStrikers may find this toggle function inconvenient, and we are working to provide an ON/OFF option in the near future.

As for Soul Force, we discovered certain system conflicts, so these adjustments will be rolled back.

Your valuable feedback will be carefully reflected in the design of future swap skills.


Electra
Encroaching Thorns knockback duration: 0.4s → 0.2s


Developer’s Notes
This adjustment ensures that opponents knocked back by Encroaching Thorns have more time to react, granting them an opportunity to counter Electra’s combo plays that revolve around Fountain of Blood.


Sabio
Rescue Grenade healing per second: 60 → 80

Rescue Grenade self-healing per second: 32 → 40


Developer’s Notes
We determined that Sabio’s healing potential showed clear limitations regardless of player mastery.

To address this, Rescue Grenade has been adjusted to provide stronger area-of-effect healing, compensating for shortcomings in large-scale team fight situations.


Other Bug Fixes & Improvements
Reorganized skill description effects listed at the bottom.

Increased maximum movement speed buff cap for all characters: 1.75 → 2.5 (up to 150% boost applied).

Fixed an issue where Shifu could not pre-cast barriers while using skills.

Fixed Warmonger’s Totem Buster slow effect applying 30% instead of 70%.

Fixed Eveleen’s Quantum Cube hit-freeze effect.

Fixed Eveleen’s Time Dilation movement speed increase applying as 25% instead of 40%.

Fixed Alice’s Divine Tempest sometimes applying abnormal damage.

Fixed Al-Manat’s Spirit of the Dune movement speed being applied as base speed increase instead of a buff.

Fixed Rei’s Frost Armor showing damage reduction/self-slow effect incorrectly as 90% instead of 70%.

Fixed Rei’s Glacial Explosion sometimes leaving residual effects when fired before charging.

Fixed Teo’s Pulse Rifle occasionally firing before being fully charged when used right after reload.

Fixed Teo’s Tactical Maneuver movement speed being applied as base speed increase instead of a buff.

Fixed Chloe’s Boing Boing, Horo Ball! causing Zoom Zoom, Horo Car! to disappear when chained.

Fixed Sabio’s Super Sabio Time! duration UI not displaying.

Fixed an issue where custom games set to private appeared as public after ending.

Fixed an issue where the redeploy function could be used while dead.

Fixed an issue where the redeploy function could not be used in certain cases.

Fixed an issue where ultimate gauge was charged after dying and respawning through redeploy at game start.

Changed hotkey settings so mouse wheel up/down can no longer be assigned.

Fixed grass in abnormal spots in Sanctuary of the Forsaken Volume map.

Fixed an issue where lobbies froze if time ran out in custom games without selecting a character.

Fixed an issue where Discord / tutorial rewards were not being granted.


System Updates
Added a Special Store tab to the shop.

The Special Store is a unique shop where items can be purchased using SC and CP.

Special packages and products will be gradually added through future updates.

Added spectator team chat functionality in custom games.

notes.title: 1.49 Update
notes.content:
1.49 Update
19 minutes ago



[p align="initial"]Hello, Storm Strikers!This is GM Maximus.
[p align="initial"]We would like to inform you about the 1.49 Update (2025.08.28).






Before the Developer’s Comment[p align="initial"]We have carefully taken into account the streams from our streamers, the 1:1 ticket history,and the valuable opinions from our Storm Strikers in the community.
[p align="initial"]For this update, our goal is to expand the volume a little more,to give you inspiration to try out new challenges,and to let you feel the joy of research.



Developer’s Comment[p align="initial"]As we mentioned in the direction of the previous update,
[p align="initial"]we focused on preserving each character’s individuality and fun, while strengthening the rhythm of combat flow and the balance between risk and return.



[p align="initial"]Maintaining strengths, adding openings
[p align="initial"]We enhanced the core identity of each hero, while also adjusting risks so that opponents can have opportunities to break through.
[p align="initial"]Improvement of control and connectivity
[p align="initial"]We refined the control feel and skill rhythm of certain heroes, and strengthened each character’s core skills and play.
[p align="initial"]Enhancement of individual combat ability
[p align="initial"]Since we judged that focusing on individual battles could be somewhat difficult in a team battle environment,
[p align="initial"]we have made some improvements to supplement individual combat ability.






Character Balance


Maximus[p align="initial"]Verdict! damage 300 → 330



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]When Maximus successfully suppresses an enemy,we have adjusted him so that he can finish the kill on his own,allowing him to become a more threatening presence even in individual combat.
Shifu[p align="initial"]Thunder Stamp cooldown 9s → 8s
[p align="initial"]Thunder Stamp movement distance 3m → 4m
[p align="initial"]Thunder Stamp after-cast delay decreased
[p align="initial"]Dragon Kick cooldown 7s → 8s
[p align="initial"]Dragon Kick attack range increased by 40%
[p align="initial"]Dragon Kick after-cast delay decreased
[p align="initial"]Dragon Kick jump height decreased



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]We have made some improvements to Shifu’s control feel,and by reducing the after-cast delay,we aimed for this skill to serve more effectively in combo connectionsrather than being used only as a single move.



Eveleen[p align="initial"]Time Dilation movement speed increased 25% → 40%
[p align="initial"]Tachyon Field shield amount 180 → 210



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]We aim to establish Eveleen as a hero who, based on explosive movement speed,can rapidly break through to the target point and push the frontline forward.
[p align="initial"]Additionally, we have slightly reduced the damage she takes during the breakthrough process,so that even when Eveleen accepts some degree of risk,she can still reach the target point and fulfill her role of dealing area damage.

Volf[p align="initial"]\[Charge] Flame On! damage 105 → 110



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]We expected Volf to pressure enemies with his Charge attack,pushing the frontline and forcing opponents to use their skills.
[p align="initial"]However, we judged that the current damage of the Charge attack was insufficient to fulfill that role in battle.
[p align="initial"]Therefore, through this adjustment,we aim to make Volf’s Charge attack more threatening,so that he can properly carry out his intended role on the battlefield.

Bernhardt[p align="initial"]Death Pursuit damage increased 150 → 155
[p align="initial"]Death Pursuit movement distance increased 525 → 575
[p align="initial"]Rampaging Fury attack range (X-axis) 75 → 125
[p align="initial"]Rampaging Fury movement distance increased 180 → 360



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]Bernhardt is now ready to swallow the battlefield whole.Go on a rampage to your heart’s content.



Akira[p align="initial"]Decimation damage 75 → 70
[p align="initial"]Dimensional Slash damage 75 → 70



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]Compared to other melee heroes, Akira has a clear advantage in seizing opportunitiesand performing them safely.
[p align="initial"]Based on this, Akira can easily create favorable situations,and we judged that such situations were occurring too frequently,causing considerable fatigue in the flow of battle.
[p align="initial"]

Therefore, while maintaining Akira’s instantaneous burst power,we have reduced the frequency with which he can seize opportunities,in order to alleviate his excessive influence.
[p align="initial"]



Alice[p align="initial"]Wind Slash first attack movement distance 3m → 4m



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]By increasing the movement distance of the first attack of Alice’s Wind Slash,we aimed to relieve some of the frustration that players felt previouslyand allow for a smoother, more comfortable play experience.

Al-Manat[p align="initial"]Sand Slash camera lock duration decreased
[p align="initial"]Arid Blade effect changed: from Slow → to Grab
[p align="initial"]Arid Blade cooldown 1.5s → 6s
[p align="initial"]Arid Blade damage 75 → 50
[p align="initial"]Arid Blade after-cast delay increased
[p align="initial"]Path to the Underworld duration 7s → 8s

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_249a2356a2034563b330d0330c40f8c3~mv2.gif"]



코멘트[p align="initial"]Despite continuous adjustment patches,we judged that the high difficulty of landing Al-Manat’s core skillsmade it difficult to fully enjoy the inherent fun of the hero.
[p align="initial"]Accordingly, through Arid Blade we have clearly reduced the burdenboth on the judgment required to use core skills and on their actual accuracy,and instead adjusted him to focus more on the infiltration processand on seizing infiltration opportunities.
[p align="initial"]We hope that the assassination playstyle of Al-Manat,which until now could only be experienced by a few skilled players,can now be enjoyed by many more of you.



Rei[p align="initial"]\[Charge] Arctic Spike damage 315 → 320
[p align="initial"]Arctic Spike cooldown reduced 4s → 1s
[p align="initial"]Glacial Explosion cooldown reduced 4s → 1s
[p align="initial"]Glacial Explosion normal attack changed: Area attack → Single attack
[p align="initial"]Glacial Explosion projectile speed increased on normal attack
[p align="initial"]Glacial Explosion charge function added
[p align="initial"]\[Charge] Glacial Explosion damage 200
[p align="initial"]Biting Hailstorm cooldown increased 7s → 9s



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]When Rei secures a position,his identity as a ranged damage dealer with consistent single-target snipingand area bombardment is maintained,but we focused on ensuring that the enemy has opportunities to break through,introducing risks and openings depending on the situation.
[p align="initial"]By removing the instant explosion effect of Glacial Explosion,if an enemy succeeds in closing the distance,Rei—when not choosing defensive skills—will find it harder to respond,as he must rely on accuracy.
[p align="initial"]We also limited the long-term area control of Biting Hailstorm,and by introducing charge times for Arctic Spike and Glacial Explosion,we intended to add openings in Rei’s gameplay.

Teo[p align="initial"]Reload speed decreased by 20%



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]We judged that Teo’s mobility through Tactical Maneuver was already sufficient.
[p align="initial"]However, we also thought that the gap created during the reloading process was excessively large,making him highly vulnerable to melee dealer-type heroes who can exploit such openings with their dash skills.
[p align="initial"]Accordingly, while still leaving room for melee dealers to break through with charge abilities,we adjusted Teo so that he also has time to respond to those who have penetrated his defenses,thereby maintaining balance between the two sides.
[p align="initial"]In addition, this adjustment is not only aimed at increasing stability,but we also hope it will allow Teo to secure competitiveness in terms of cumulative damage output,so that he can stand on equal footing with other ranged dealer heroes.



Lightning[p align="initial"]Overall aspects of the hero Lightning have been improved.
[p align="initial"]Since the overall values have been changed,please be sure to check the detailed specifications in-game.



[p align="initial"]Passive Skill Changes
[p align="initial"]\[Agility] Base movement speed increased by +150
[p align="initial"]\[Sword Dance] Lightning can gracefully connect various skills,allowing some skills to be linked more quickly than others.
[p align="initial"]Example: During the casting of Radiant Dance,Spiral Stinger can be connected faster than other skills,enabling Lightning to escape from the battlefield.



[p align="initial"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_2566c1e985bc4ab0ab7baf95e1df6ed6~mv2.gif"]




Key Slot Changes
[p align="initial"]RMB – Sword Engage / Lightning Drive / Northern Light
[p align="initial"]E – Spiral Stinger / Lightning Drive / Northern Light / Shooting Star
[p align="initial"]R – Shooting Star / Radiant Dance
[p align="initial"]Shift – Lightning Accel




[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_9f55c03cb939449ebf518b1830a0f473~mv2.gif"]










Skill Effect Changes
[p align="initial"]Radiant Dance: casting delay → grants invincibility immediately upon casting
[p align="initial"]Radiant Dance: invincibility duration decreased 0.8s → 0.65s
[p align="initial"]Lightning Accel: maximum uses decreased 3 → 2
[p align="initial"]Lightning Accel: added \[Dash] function in the direction of movement keys
[p align="initial"]Shooting Star: \[Airborne] effect removed




Skill Delay Reduction
[p align="initial"]The casting speed of certain skills has been increased,and their after-cast delay has been reduced.




[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_956ac22ab6a7408da5787dae863d55e2~mv2.gif"]



Comment[p align="initial"]We judged that, in the previous state, Lightning’s skills and basic attacks were not clearly distinguished in terms of usage timing,making it difficult to focus on a single playstyle during combat.
[p align="initial"]Accordingly, we separated the combat rhythm into \[basic attack play] that utilizes Illusion Slash and Lightning Accel,and \[skill-focused play] based on other skills,so that Lightning can concentrate on a playstyle that highlights his strengths within a clearer tempo.
[p align="initial"]For the \[basic attack play] using Illusion Slash and Lightning Accel,we reduced the cooldown of Lightning Accel and increased its shield amount,granting greater strength to sustained combat centered around basic attacks.
[p align="initial"]Based on the reduced skill delays and the \[Sword Dance] passive,we intended for various skills to be combined and linked,so that after skill-focused play, the style can naturally flow into \[basic attack play].
[p align="initial"]However, we judged that the explosive damage resulting from compressed speedhas significant variability in how it is felt during actual combat situations.Therefore, in this update, we have adjusted some of the damage.
[p align="initial"]For now, our focus is on completing the individuality and fun of the hero,and we will proceed with additional follow-up adjustments afterward.



Narae[p align="initial"]Soul Force damage per second 100 → 60
[p align="initial"]Soul Force healing per second 100 → 20
[p align="initial"]Soul Force now assigned to RMB slot
[p align="initial"]Blessing of Grace shield amount increased 240 → 280



[p align="initial"]

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_85dc43a4078d4b60917ff07efbe59298~mv2.gif"]



Comment[p align="initial"]We wanted Narae to give more of an impression of being a teammatewho participates in battle while breathing together with allies than before.
[p align="initial"]This change has somewhat of an experimental nature,so the control feel may be awkward, or the efficiency may be excessive or insufficient.
[p align="initial"]However, ultimately, we want to take this as an adventure and challenge,so that in the future, with the addition of swap skills,Narae can firmly take her place as a hero who creates battles together with her team.



Chloe[p align="initial"]Tag! Freeze! now assigned to R slot



[p align="initial"]Comment
[p align="initial"]As overall kill opportunities have increased,we wanted to provide Chloe with room to adopt a survival skill.






Other Bug Fixes and Improvements[p align="initial"]The Hero Introduction section will be changed from Story → Character Traits.
[p align="initial"]Some skill descriptions have been improved.
[p align="initial"]Hero passive skill descriptions have been moved into the basic skill description section.
[p align="initial"]Fixed an issue where Warmonger – Flex Harder! did not apply movement speed reduction when used.
[p align="initial"]Fixed an issue where Lightning’s Limit Break did not apply the \[Unstoppable] effect upon activation.
[p align="initial"]Adjusted the effect of Lightning’s Northern Light to match its attack range.
[p align="initial"]Adjusted the effect of Lightning’s Shooting Star to match its attack range.
[p align="initial"]Improved Al-Manat – Hashashin so that additional attacks are triggered even when hitting a tanker’s \[Barrier].
[p align="initial"]Added the missing \[Airborne] description to Electra’s Encroaching Thorns.






System[p align="initial"]A function to display the list of Custom Game Rooms has been added.

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_976520be04584dca9888549731cfca3c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_506,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/b4cc35_976520be04584dca9888549731cfca3c~mv2.png"]



Profile Icons Added[p align="initial"]1st Queen, 2nd Queen, Streamer Lucy, Clan War

notes.title: 1.48.2 Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello, StormStriker players!This is GM Maximus.

Here’s the information for the 1.48.2 Update (2025.08.08).


Future Balance Direction
While keeping each character’s unique personality and fun factor as our top priority, we plan to adjust balance in the following ways:



1. Enhance the thrill of turning the tide
We will strengthen each character’s core skills while making small adjustments to others to maintain overall balance.


2. Encourage strategic combat flow
To add more strategic depth to battles, we may increase cooldowns for certain skills.

In return, each skill will be given a clearer purpose.


3. Reinforce goal-oriented play
We will work to clearly define everything from the team’s shared victory objectives to each character’s detailed gameplay goals.


Developer’s Comment
Large-scale balance changes in a short period can cause a big impact on gameplay feel.

However, frequent changes can also create adaptation fatigue for StormStriker players.

We plan to adjust balance gradually and steadily over time.For now, this patch applies only a limited set of adjustments.



Character Balance

Bernhardt
Removed passive lifesteal.

Frenzied Dance: 30 → 20.

Bloodthirst instant HP recovery: 250 → 200.

Bloodthirst lifesteal: 25% → 40%.

Blitzkrieg cooldown: 6s → 7s.

Savage Dash cooldown: 7s → 8s.

Rampaging Fury damage: 105 → 100.

Inferno Strike damage: 195 → 225.

Inferno Strike cooldown: 7s → 8s.

Eternal Hellblade: attack speed of the initial strike increased by 50%.


Comment

Removed the always-on lifesteal, which gave excessive sustain without a healing-reduction system.

Kept the movement speed increase on Frenzied Dance hits so Bernhardt can still apply some CC and respond even without Rage stacks.

notes.title: Version 1.44 Update
notes.content:
Hello, Storm Striker players!
We’d like to share the details of the 1.44 update (March 27, 2025).


Overall Balance Adjustment Direction

 In version 1.43, we attempted to create a more favorable environment for melee dealers by artificially removing certain crowd control (CC) effects or increasing their cooldowns.
 However, as we adjusted the balance in line with this approach, we found that some characters lost core skills that were key to their fun and identity, ultimately reducing their overall appeal.
 As a result, rather than continuing to remove CCs artificially, we’ve decided to improve the usability of movement skills for melee characters. This will allow players to use their own skill combinations more freely and naturally evade CC effects.
 In the 1.43 patch, we also increased the burst DPS of dealers across the board.
 However, this led to situations where players were defeated before they even had a chance to respond, reducing the opportunity for back-and-forth combat.
 To address this, we’re reverting the stats to their 1.42 patch values so players can better engage and respond during fights. (For example: when Rei and Lucy's LMB damage was at 105.)
 We’ll first explain the changes that were made in the 1.42 patch, followed by the final stat adjustments to be applied.



Shifu

 Intent

 Following the adjustments to Shifu in version 1.43, the character has re-emerged in the meta.
 At the moment, we see this as a positive direction and are planning to apply version 1.43 changes to version 1.42.
 However, Shifu’s ultimate in 1.43 had excessively high damage output, often turning a 5v5 into a sudden 4v5 and heavily shifting the flow of team fights.
 To address this, we plan to adjust the skill's focus from raw damage to sustained survivability.

 Extreme Dragon Fist 

 Damage: 360 (10 hits) / 360 → 110 (10 hits) / 330
 Healing: 720 (10 ticks) → 960 (10 ticks)

 Dragon Fist 

 Hitbox size adjusted: 200 / 100 / 150 → 225 / 115 / 150




Volf

 Intent

 As a tank who frequently relies on shields, Volf has struggled with maintaining combat tempo due to an awkward charge mechanic.
 To address this, we’ve improved convenience by allowing passion gauge charging even while using a shield.
 Additionally, the underperforming skill Fiery Uppercut has received a new passive effect—instant full charge on hit—to give a meaningful boost to Volf's current performance.

 Passion gauge can now be charged while the skill is active.
 Flame On!’s charge speed is reduced to 50%.

 Fiery Uppercut

 Cooldown: 2.5s → 4.5s




Akira

 Dimensional Slash has been reverted to RMB, as it was in the 2024 version.
 With this change, Akira can now be played in two distinct styles: a fast-paced, dash-heavy Decimation build focused on multi-hit lifesteal, or a slower, long-range projectile-based setup.
 Additionally, to improve combo fluidity, Battōjutsu can now be reused after completing the LMB → LMB → RMB 3-cycle combo.
 Third Eye has once again been updated to grant the Unstoppable effect.

 With this patch, Alice will now be able to chase targets moving at base speed using just her LMB attacks.

 Intent

 Frost Barrier has been adjusted for smoother usability when used as a survival tool. With this change, both new players and Rei mains will be able to respond more quickly in critical situations by using it more intuitively.
 As for Frost Armor, we determined that its long duration was excessively disrupting the timing of enemy attacks, negatively affecting the gameplay experience of melee dealers. To address this, we’ve added a stronger damage reduction to effectively block major attacks, while significantly reducing the duration.

Hello, Storm Striker Players!
We are excited to introduce the 1.43 Update (25.02.27).
This update includes balance adjustments and minor client updates.


Overall Balance Adjustment Direction
The main focus of this balance update is to alleviate the frustration and unfairness melee dealers have been experiencing due to excessive crowd control (CC) effects. Moving forward, powerful CC abilities like stuns will be exclusive to tanks.

Melee dealers will now have ample time to shine if they make smart decisions regarding the use of tank abilities. However, as CC frequency has been significantly reduced, some melee dealers will have their sustain adjusted accordingly.

Previously, the optimal strategy was to disable melee dealers with CC before eliminating them. Now, the approach will shift towards focusing them down using the increased DPS of ranged dealers.

notes.title: StormStriker Returns!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the StormStriker Development Team.

We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of our players who have supported and patiently waited for StormStriker.

Over the past months, we have been working tirelessly to improve StormStriker and searching for ways to share the game's unique charm with a broader audience.

As the first step, we are excited to announce that starting next week, we will host special community-centered events and embark on a renewed journey to shape the game together with all of you.



1. Weekly Events and Rewards!

To ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all StormStriker players, we will be hosting weekly events centered around our Discord community.

In the initial phase, regular matchmaking will remain temporarily disabled, and we will assist players with matchmaking through Discord to provide a better and more controlled gameplay environment. Further details on how this system will operate will be shared soon.

Additionally, to make these events even more engaging, we have prepared small rewards for everyone to enjoy while participating. Through these events, we hope to create an opportunity to connect with all of you, share the fun of the game, and foster stronger communication.

The detailed schedule and reward information will be announced on our Discord community, so please stay tuned!







2. Skill Slot 4-Slot Restoration Test

In our previous announcement, we explained our decision to reduce the skill slots to three as part of our effort to make StormStriker more accessible to a broader audience. However, based on your valuable feedback, we have decided to restore the skill slots back to four and conduct further testing.

For this test, we have not only restored the skill slots to four but also made several adjustments to improve accessibility. We would like to see how these changes affect the flow of combat and overall gameplay, and we hope to evaluate them together with all of you.

After reviewing the results of this test and gathering your feedback, we will also determine the potential introduction of the "Trait System" to further enhance the game’s depth.

We greatly appreciate your active participation and honest feedback during this testing phase. Your insights will be the driving force behind StormStriker’s continued growth and improvement.

Every single one of your opinions helps make StormStriker a more enjoyable and engaging game!

Please join us for this important test and share your thoughts with us. We look forward to hearing from you!



3. Building StormStriker Together with Our Players

We are deeply committed to making StormStriker an enjoyable and engaging game for everyone, and we will do our utmost to ensure that it becomes a game loved and played by many. To achieve this, we firmly believe that StormStriker is not just our creation as a development team but a game that we build together with all of you, our valued players.

Our goal is to listen to your feedback, communicate openly, and continually improve the game. Starting with the upcoming events and tests, we will strive to make StormStriker a game that more players can enjoy and love.

By centering our efforts around the community that supports StormStriker, we aim to strengthen the game and expand the player base.

We are eager to hear your feedback and ensure that StormStriker evolves into a game that brings fun and excitement to as many players as possible. Thank you for being part of this journey with us!



We invite you to join us as we embark on this new chapter for StormStriker.

Thank you.

Sincerely,The StormStriker Development Team

notes.title: The Development Team's Thoughts on the Skill Changes
notes.content:
Hello, this is the StormStriker Development Team.
First and foremost, we sincerely thank all of our players who have supported StormStriker for such a long time. Your passion and dedication have made StormStriker what it is today, and this has been a tremendous source of strength for us.
It has already been over a month since we began official communication with you.
During this time, we carefully reviewed the feedback you provided during the CBT. We have spent countless hours discussing, debating, and testing ideas to determine how we can create an environment where more players can join StormStriker, enjoy smooth matchmaking with similarly skilled opponents, and experience the kind of gameplay that only StormStriker can provide.
Our development team loves playing StormStriker just as much as you do, and we take pride in the game’s unique charm and enjoyment. Like you, we want to preserve what makes StormStriker special, but at the same time, we are constantly thinking about how we can attract more players to the game.
Starting today, we would like to share our thoughts and plans over several updates to explain what the development team is working on to ensure StormStriker’s success.
For our first topic, we want to address the most frequently discussed issue: the number of skill slots.


Background and Considerations Behind the Skill Slot Change
Our development team genuinely loves StormStriker and is dedicated to creating a game that we, as players, can also enjoy. We share the same passion for this game as our players do, and we are committed to improving it and guiding it in a better direction. In this sense, we see ourselves as both passionate fans and dedicated players.
This is why we carefully considered how changes to the number of skill slots might impact StormStriker's gameplay and overall enjoyment. We fully understand the weight of this decision and the concerns it raises.
Nevertheless, we would like to explain why we made this change, as well as how we plan to address the issues of reduced enjoyment and diminished character identity that may have arisen as a result.


Challenges StormStriker Faces: Limited Matchmaking Pool
We have identified two primary reasons why StormStriker has not yet reached its full potential:

 A lack of players, leading to unbalanced and inconsistent matchmaking.
 StormStriker's unique appeal is not being effectively showcased.

Through analysis of Steam reviews, we found that over 30% of negative feedback cited issues with matchmaking. It is understandable that players would leave negative reviews if they cannot properly enjoy the game due to matchmaking difficulties.
Furthermore, a small player base often results in matches that combine players of vastly different skill levels, creating even higher barriers for new players to enjoy the game. (We are currently working on solutions to address these matchmaking issues, which we will explain in detail at a later time.)


Identifying the Root Cause of New Player Drop-off
The challenges faced by StormStriker cannot simply be resolved with more advertising. Even when new players join, many struggle to adapt to the game, and drop-off rates remain high, even in cases where they do not experience matchmaking issues.
To address this, we carefully analyzed the gameplay data of new players who had difficulty adapting to the game. Our focus was on identifying the fundamental reasons behind their struggles.


Analysis Results: Choice Overload and Difficulty in Quick Decision-Making
Our analysis revealed that while some players struggled with the fast-paced nature of the game, this was not the core issue. Many fast-paced games have achieved success, so we shifted our focus to a deeper, more critical factor.
The most significant finding was difficulty in responding effectively to combat situations in real time. Players often struggled to decide which skill to use in unexpected scenarios, leading to frustration and a lack of satisfaction in their gameplay experience.


Four Skills Can Be Overwhelming for Players New to the Game
According to Hick-Hyman's Law and Cognitive Load Theory, having too many choices in a high-pressure situation makes it difficult for the average person to adapt. This is why most games limit the number of options in real-time scenarios to three to four choices at most.
Even in games, binary or ternary choices (two or three options) are common, but when quick decision-making is required, having four or more options is rarely utilized. Our analysis of other successful PvP games that demand real-time decision-making revealed that most focus on three core abilities for moment-to-moment gameplay, excluding ultimate skills.
However, StormStriker offered up to five simultaneous options (four skills and an ultimate), excluding basic attacks. While this provided a challenge for highly skilled players, it became an overwhelming burden for players less familiar with the game.
As a result, many new players struggled with skill selection, making it harder for them to adapt and ultimately leading to higher drop-off rates. Based on this analysis, we concluded that reducing the number of skill slots is a critical step toward creating a more accessible environment for new players while mitigating choice overload.


Decision to Reduce Skill Slots to Three to Attract New Players
After much deliberation, we decided that reducing momentary options to three skills aligns better with StormStriker’s fast tempo, making it more accessible and appealing to a wider audience.
This change aims to help new players adapt more easily while allowing experienced players to continue enjoying StormStriker’s depth through strategic gameplay.


Enhancing the Trait System and Skill Swap System
To compensate for reducing the number of skill slots, we introduced long-term strategic options to maintain depth in the gameplay. This led to the implementation of the ‘Trait’ system.
Traits are designed to provide situational choices in each battle, enabling players to make more thoughtful decisions that align with their team’s strategic needs.
Additionally, we enhanced StormStriker’s unique Skill Swap System to allow for greater flexibility in skill configurations. Players can now adapt their skills freely during combat, moving beyond split-second decisions and focusing on overall strategy.
This system retains the fun and intensity of skill-based combat while delivering a unique and differentiated experience that is exclusive to StormStriker.
Furthermore, this change empowers players to become true masters of their chosen heroes.
Instead of switching to a different hero when things aren’t going well, players can adapt to situations by using Traits and Skill Swaps with their current hero. This enables players to deeply understand their hero, make the best use of its potential in various scenarios, and experience the joy of becoming “a player who fully masters their hero.”


Feedback on the First Version Presented During the CBT
During the last CBT, we introduced a version of the game with the skill slots reduced to three for the first time. Many players provided invaluable feedback on this change.
Here is a summary of the key points raised:

 The reduction in skill slots diminished the individuality of the characters.
 Characters designed around skill combos lost their intended playstyles as the reduced slots made certain combos impossible.
 For specific roles such as tanking or team support, players had to select certain skills, but after using them, they felt powerless with no further options available.

Players gave detailed examples using various characters to highlight these issues.
We deeply empathize with this feedback and have been seriously considering solutions to address these concerns.


Feedback Analysis and Solutions
Based on player feedback, we reached the following conclusion:

 The original characters were designed with four skill slots in mind, which caused their unique playstyles to collapse when the number of skill slots was reduced.

To resolve this issue, we have been considering ways to make the game more accessible to a wider audience while preserving the characters' individuality and unique playstyles.
The solution we arrived at is to redesign each character's skills.
Our goal is to ensure that even with three skill slots, each character’s playstyle remains distinct and their individuality shines through. At the same time, we aim to adapt skill combos that were originally designed for four slots to work seamlessly with three.


The First Example of a Complete 3-Skill Revision: Akira

Akira's Redesign Goal: “3 Skills That Feel Like 4”
We are currently prioritizing adjustments for characters whose playstyles have been affected by the skill slot changes. Today, we are excited to introduce Akira as the first example of this redesign.

[previewyoutube=hCnjb5RSsGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

While Akira may not deliver the exact same feel as when the character had four skills, we have confirmed that even with only three skills, it is still possible to create an engaging and enjoyable playstyle; this serves as a promising example of how characters can retain their unique essence while being adapted to fit the new skill system. We view these changes as a thoughtful step forward, ensuring that heroes maintain their distinctiveness while aligning with the updated framework.

Starting with Akira, we plan to revisit the skill compositions and playstyles of every hero, carefully redesigning them to preserve the signature fun of StormStriker while simultaneously crafting a game that is more accessible to a broader audience. This endeavor, however, is not a simple task; the process is as demanding as redesigning the game from the ground up, and as such, we cannot adjust all heroes at once. Nonetheless, we are committed to advancing this work as quickly as possible to present you with a polished and refined final product.

During the previous CBT, it was evident that reducing the skill slots from four to three without adjusting the overall balance of the heroes led to broken playstyles or rendered certain characters incapable of fulfilling their intended roles; this outcome, while unfortunate, was entirely predictable given the lack of compensatory changes. However, in the reimagined version of StormStriker, we are actively working to ensure that each hero’s concept-driven and role-specific gameplay can be fully realized with only three skill slots.

That being said, given the time-intensive nature of this redesign process, there are still heroes for whom adjustments remain incomplete. In such cases, we will focus on fine-tuning elements such as skill balance, cooldowns, and input timing to ensure that, even with only the existing three skills, the heroes’ playstyles feel cohesive and enjoyable; this will allow players to continue having fun while we work towards completing the broader redesign.


Help Us Make StormStriker Even More Enjoyable Together
Our single goal is clear: to create a game that all players can enjoy playing.
Your feedback plays a crucial role in the process of revamping the skill system, and we deeply value your input.
To achieve this, we will actively utilize our Discord community to conduct regular tests and incorporate your suggestions as we continuously refine the game.
We have shared the reasons behind reducing the skill slots from four to three and the direction we are taking moving forward. We will continue to share our thoughts and plans with you, seeking your valuable feedback along the way.
Our commitment is to ensure that StormStriker remains a game with unique and compelling fun, while also growing its player base to become a game you can always log into and enjoy whenever you want.
Thank you.

— The StormStriker Development Team

notes.title: 2nd quarter roadmap and important events
notes.content:
Hello, Storm Strikers!
In this post, we want to discuss what the development team is targeting for the second quarter and what important events we are preparing for.

The article is a bit long, but I would appreciate your interest.



2nd quarter roadmap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/096fd99dc8ad9fd834b750d592e6df01b4171cf8.png

First, the list of tasks selected by each team for the second quarter is as shown above.
Our goal is to complete at least 3 or more of these.
Below, we will explain why these tasks were chosen for our work list.



Technical Team
Shop
The store system is essential for the ongoing operation of the game.
Having a store allows players to spend the in-game currency they've earned,
which can provide a small but significant motivation to play the game.
Therefore, the development of the store system is our top priority.

Mission
The mission system provides players with daily and weekly missions to give them short-term motivation to play.
Currently, the fun of playing the game is the sole reason to play, which we believe is too much of a burden.
To alleviate this, we think developing a mission system is appropriate.

Hero Mastery
There are players, including some of our staff, who only play specific heroes.
To make the game more enjoyable for these players, we believe a system where playing a hero increases their mastery, unlocking skills, titles, emotes, and other items, would be beneficial. It also allows players to show off their understanding of the hero to others.

Account Leveling
Sometimes, hero mastery alone might not fully show how well someone knows Storm Striker.
We think an account leveling system, by revealing the account level to others, can compensate for this.

Hero Rotation
We plan to sell heroes, but obviously, new players will not have any heroes initially.
Therefore, we're preparing a system that offers a set of heroes that can be used on a weekly or monthly basis.

Optimization
We've made several optimizations but believe there's still more we can do.
Providing a smoother gameplay experience remains a priority for us.


Design Team
Modern Mode
Modern Mode is a system that exchanges attack power for accuracy.
This is a solution to one of the biggest challenges the design team has faced.

From data gathered over the last six months, we found a significant problem:
70% of new players choosing melee heroes in their first match do not play the game again.
Most of these players did not even achieve 30% of the average damage.
In contrast, new players who chose support or ranged heroes in their first match continued to play in 80% of cases, and they rarely quit the game mid-match even if they chose a melee hero later.

This suggests that new players selecting melee heroes struggle to survive in the game.
We believe the root cause is a lack of enjoyment due to not being able to deal damage or feeling useless in the game.

Modern Mode aims to address this by systemically assisting melee heroes to land their skills, even at the cost of reducing their damage by 25%.

Maximus and Alice will be the first to receive this adjustment on April 11 for testing. Based on the outcomes, we plan to consider applying it to all melee heroes.

Shifu Release
Originally, we planned to release Shifu in March.
However, we realized in March that we needed to rebalance before adding new heroes.
Electra was rushed out due to high anticipation, leading to ongoing adjustments post-release.
We intend to prepare Shifu for a higher quality release.

Replacement skill expansion
Currently, Storm Striker have no hero swapping and growth elements.
We believe the skill change system is a unique feature that needs expansion for players to enjoy mixing various skills for combat.
We aim to prepare two swap skills per slot to offer broader choices.

Improvement of unused skills
Unfortunately, some replacement skills are currently seen as unnecessary.
These unused skills fail to showcase Storm Striker' appeal.
We aim to improve these skills to encourage players to think about which ones to use based on the situation.

Balancing
Balance adjustments are an ongoing challenge for PVP games.
We plan to introduce changes to various skills and add new heroes, always aiming to maintain enjoyable gameplay.


Art Team
Effect Improvements
We have long recognized the issue that effects make it difficult to discern the battlefield situation. To address this, the art team has defined several rules for effects, and in the update at the end of March, we have started changing some skills to effects that improve visibility. We will continue to improve effects in the second quarter to ensure the screen is not cluttered.

Sound Improvements
Hearing is also a sense used to comprehend the battlefield situation. We have identified that currently, many unnecessary sounds are being played. We plan to refine this by focusing on essential sounds while still enhancing game immersion.

New Hero Production
Following Siphu, we are in the process of creating a hero named Lightning. We are committed to creating an attractive hero.

Trailer Production
Like other games, we believe Storm Striker also needs a trailer that is separate from in-game footage, one that encapsulates the world and the narrative story of Storm Striker. However, we prioritize quality in trailer production, so even if it takes a long time, we will prepare to present it with a high level of completion, even if it means showing it to our users later.

Cinematic Video Production
We regret not preparing even a simple story video for the release of Electra. Cinematic videos are short animations that explain each hero's story and the world. Starting with the hero Lightning, we plan to prepare and show videos that can raise anticipation for new heroes before their release.



About Early Access and Official Release
To solve the development team's concerns together with our users, we launched an early access on November 17 last year. Through early access, we have learned a lot from our users and accumulated know-how on operation. We originally planned for the early access period to be six months, which makes May 17 the six-month mark. We do not yet have a plan for what to do on May 17, so it is difficult to give a definitive answer to our users about future plans.

However, one thing we can say for certain is that Storm Striker will definitely have an official release. We anticipate this could be as early as the beginning of Q4 or as late as the end of Q4.

It's true that we are in a difficult and challenging situation due to the lack of players. But we haven't given up because we believe that once we have shown everything about the game, our users will enjoy it. For now, all we can ask is for you to trust us. The game is still lacking in many ways and there's much left to develop, but we will not give up, and we would be grateful if our users could also keep their faith in us.



Lastly, Regarding Developer Comments
As the person responsible for writing this notice, I have always believed that it is right for our users to see the content and form their own answers regarding announcements, patch notes, and official statements from the development side. I have been cautious about adding developer comments to explain and interpret on their behalf. However, writing this has made me reconsider my stance. Going forward, while it may be difficult to comment on every item, we will make sure to add comments, especially on aspects that may be sensitive to our users, so that our intentions are clearly communicated.

Thank you for reading this long message.

notes.content:
Hello, Storm Striker community!
Thank you for patiently waiting for the next patch for such a long time.
The patch will take place from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM KST (Korean Standard Time) on March 7, 2024.

Thank you.



Systems
- Respawn time reduced from 14 to 10.
- Increased capture speed for bases/cargo by 10%.

This is the core focus of this patch. We aim to accelerate the pace of the game by reducing respawn time and increasing capture speed.

Sound
- Improved guard sound.
- Adjusted character sound balance.

We expect to increase the impact of gameplay by adjusting the balance of character sounds based on sound priority and improving guard sounds.

Characters
▶Raky
- Cat Punch (RMB1) 1st hit damage: 175 → 200

Most of Rocky's first hit with Cat Punch is wasted. We've contemplated how to prevent the first hit from being wasted, and for now, we'd like to apply the same damage as the second hit.


▶Lucy
- Bloody Shot (LMB1) hit damage: 40 → 30
- Bloody Shot (LMB1) splash damage: 80 → 70
- Scarlet Banish (RMB1) damage: 50 → 100
- Scarlet Hook (RMB2) damage: 10 → 15 (Total damage: 50 → 75)
- Scarlet Hook (RMB2) cooldown: 10 → 8
- Vermilion Hand (E1) damage: 50 → 100
- Vermilion Hand (E1) cooldown: 14 → 12
- Bloody Burst (R1) damage: 200 → 250 (125/125)
- Bloody Burst (R1) removed stickiness

Lucy's initial concept is that of a skill-based dealer.
Lucy's damage with Bloody Shot at 120 was overshadowing Ray's position considerably.
Therefore, to allow her to excel using skills rather than basic attacks,
most of her other skills have been buffed while reducing the damage of basic attacks.


▶Bernhard
- Dance of Madness (LMB) Rage gained: 20 → 25
- Pursuit of Death (RMB1) 2nd hit damage: 125 → 150
- Wrathful Fury (RMB2) post-delay: 1.5 → 0.9
- Wrathful Fury (RMB2) fixed an issue with skill defense penetration
- Hell Drop (R1) upper range: 450 → 600
- Torrent of Rage (R2) cooldown: 6 → 4
- Torrent of Rage (R2) removed slow effect

The greatest fun of Bernhardt lies in the constant use of his RMB skills.
Therefore, in this patch, adjustments have been made to allow Bernhardt to gather rage more effectively,
moving in a direction where he can have greater potential.


▶Eveleen

- Time Expansion (E2) cooldown: 12 → 10

Further research is needed to understand the impact of buffing movement speed on our game.
The original cooldown of 12 seconds was too long, so we have reduced it to allow for more utility.


▶Warmonger

- Fixed an issue where the damage of Shoulder Tackle (Shift1) was not consistently applied.

This was deemed a critical bug in War Monger's combo, so we quickly addressed it.

notes.title: Notice of the Storm Battle System & Implementation
notes.content:
Hello, this is the marketing team of Storm Striker.

In an effort to foster a gaming culture where we can all enjoy together, we have implemented the Storm Battle System. This decision was made after monitoring most of your broadcasts and gaining a clear understanding from both users and streamers. At StormStriker, we believe "It's more fun when we play together."
The Storm Battle System is a collaborative effort with users and streamers who truly enjoy SS. We believe it holds substantial value, even if it takes time to develop. We plan to continuously improve and evolve this system in sync with all of you, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do.

Thank you.

>

#What is the Storm Battle System?
A system where a single streamer can form two or more teams, receive support, and organize battles.

#StormStreamer Benefits
Benefit 1. 'Storm Streamer' gets the right to host battles
Benefit 2. Streamers earn points based on participant numbers during a hosted battle [Number of Participants x 50] e.g., [10 people x 50 = Total 500 points]
*Early Bird Benefit: The first 10 applicants for the battle receive [Number of Participants x 100] points
Benefit 3. Points totaling 5000 or more can be monetized (Twitch = 25,000 Bits / AfreecaTV = 5000 Star Balloons)
Benefit 4. Upon achieving 5000 points, upgrade to Super StormStreamer: In-game creation of a unique character profile, increased cash unit, and various additional benefits

#Benefits for Battle Participants
Active participants in the streamer battles will be rewarded with icons and other incentives (details to be announced later).

#Application Q&A
- How to Apply: Fill out the Google form and send a DM to SS_HAN
- English: https://forms.gle/FSi3fJfXPn7r4FTj7
- Streamers can participate in other streamers' battles (broadcasting is mandatory)
- Users & Streamers can rejoin the same streamer's battles, but will not be counted for point allocation

#Basic Format for Battles
- Storm Warrior Slots: Every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 8pm / First come, first served
- Best of 5 (BO5) is recommended (you can propose your own rules after consultation)
- All participants must participate with voice & streamers must broadcast ON

#Procedure
1. Submit a storm battle application to the management staff
2. After approval, monitoring is checked with the broadcast link shared on the disc during the broadcast.
3. Upon completion of the battle, you will be rewarded if you share participants information with the management team.

#Compliance
- Streamers who use profanity or derogatory language during the battle, or act in a way that tarnishes their dignity, may have their qualifications permanently revoked.
- Participants who intentionally act in a way that harms the development of the battle culture may also have their participation rights permanently revoked.
- We plan to continuously revise and improve the implementation plan in a constructive direction (retroactive application of existing plans).
- Once the battle culture is established, we plan to introduce a StormStreamer Championship system as well.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Intro


Hi everyone at Storm Striker! This is Alphakaman, the head of the Design team!

We're having a blast these days, busy preparing for the patch!

After the launch, we noticed quite a few areas that needed improvement. This patch is all about addressing those issues as quickly as we can, focusing on what we can implement right away!

I'll break down the details of the patch for you, item by item!



Major Changes

Ladder Point (LP) System


Ladder Points will be a way for you guys to measure your skills numerically until Rank Matches are introduced! But since it's not a Rank Match yet, we've made it so it's not visible to others, so you don't need to feel too pressured about it.




 You can check your LP in your profile and match result screens.
 If you leave the game before it starts (known as "deserting"), your LP will significantly decrease.
 If you leave the game after it has started (known as "dodging"), your LP will slightly decrease.
 The introduction of this system will result in the reset of your MMR (Match Making Rating).


Chat System


We know the in-game chat system has been lacking, making communication with other players challenging. This patch focuses on improving basic chats, especially with friends.




 Chatting is now possible on the game result screen.
 Party chat in the lobby has been added.
 Whisper chat with friends has been added.
 Chatting in custom game lobbies is now available.


Early Access Pass Expansion


To enrich your in-game rewards before the regular season pass and store are added, we've expanded the Early Access Pass.




 Early Access Pass now extends from a maximum of 15 tiers to 65 tiers.


HUD Changes


We've made the HUD cleaner and adjusted the camera position for more thrilling gameplay.




 The design of the HUD has been changed.


Camera Position Adjustment


 The distance between the character and camera has been slightly reduced.
 The camera has been slightly moved to the right of the character.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/e414ebb11108b5b4c6981b07942fb137f3b5dbbd.png
The current game screen in development

Game Timing Adjustments


To provide more breathing room in the game, as battles were deemed too continuous, we've adjusted respawn and point increase times.




 Respawn time increased: 12s → 14s
 Point increase speed in control games decreased: 1ps → 0.9ps
 Point increase speed in conquest games decreased: 0.5ps → 0.45ps


Self-Healing Increase


In Storm Striker, characters start healing themselves 3 seconds after taking damage. To facilitate smoother gameplay for characters other than healers, we've increased the self-healing rate for non-healer characters.




 Narae, Chloe, Sabio's HP recovery per second increased: 75ps → 80ps
 All characters except Narae, Chloe, Sabio: HP recovery per second increased : 40ps → 60ps


Optimization


After identifying optimization issues post-launch, we've improved areas negatively impacting optimization, removed unused features, and lightly tuned VFX. We'll continue to focus on optimization in future patches, even if not explicitly mentioned.



Training Ground Improvements


 Added character change feature
 Added damage meter feature
 Bot characters can now be the same as the player's character


Hitbox Height Adjustment


We've adjusted the hitbox heights of some skills, which were too high compared to their visual representation. For Akira, we've slightly increased the size of the hitbox, which was too low even to avoid by jumping.




 Volf's Righteous Strike (R) top hitbox adjusted from 400 to 300, bottom from 0 to 150
 Bernhard's Inferno Strike (R1) top hitbox adjusted from 600 to 300, bottom from 600 to 150
 Alice's Gale Strike (R) charging top hitbox from 500 to 400, bottom from 100 to 150
 Akira's Battōjutsu (R) basic top hitbox from 100 to 150, bottom from 100 to 150
 Akira's Battōjutsu (R) Empowered top hitbox from 100 to 150, bottom from 100 to 150


Sabio Adjustments


Initially, Sabio was designed as a character with hit-scan attacks, leaning more towards a damage dealer. However, upon observing players' gameplay, we noticed a significant disparity between the low and high points of hit-scan. Realizing the game lacked enough healers and that leaving Sabio as a damage-focused healer was problematic, we've adjusted Sabio to be more of a hybrid between a healer and a dealer. The high points as a dealer are lowered, and the low points are raised, transferring some of the dealer capabilities to enhance the healer role.



Golden Spear of Kukulkan(LMB)


 Attack range increased: 50 → 125
 With the increased attack range, the Rei effect may appear curved from the reticle.
 Base damage reduced: : 70 → 50
 Empowered damage while using Nitro Gliding (Shift) reduced : 120 → 70
 Range for triggering additional hits from drones on impact reduced : 30m → 20m


Guardian Automata of Kukulkan(RMB)


 Healing amount increased : 250 → 300
 Duration increased : 2s → 3s
 Cooldown reduced : 4s → 3s


Rescue Grenade(E1)


 Continuous healing reduced : 100ps → 75ps
 Healing effect on Sabio reduced to half


Reaction Grenade(E2)


 Damage increased : 50 → 100
 Swapped the buttons for E2 (Rescue Grenade) and E1 (Reaction Grenade)


Al Manat Adjustments


Al Manat's reliance on the LMB → E → LMB combo was considered too strong, so we've adjusted it to reduce its dominance. While the combo can be enjoyable, the skill gap between those who know it and those who don't was too significant. Additionally, Al Manat's evasive capabilities made it too challenging for opponents to track her. We've slightly reduced the effectiveness of her Shift skill to make her position easier to anticipate.



Throwing Daggers(LMB)


 Damage reduced: 110 → 90
 Fire rate reduced: 0.75 → 0.5


Arid Blade(E1)


 Damage increased: 50 → 75
 Cooldown increased: 1.5 → 3


Talon of the Desert(E2)


 Damage increased: 50 → 75


Spirit of the Dune(Shift)


 Movement speed starts at 150% and gradually slows down
 Cancels on being stunned


Volf


Volf, a tank character boasting high win rates lately, has been adjusted. While maintaining his appeal as a mobile and powerful tank, we've reduced his health to balance his strength.




 Maximum health reduced: 1000 → 900


Eveleen


Eveleen players felt too much pressure using the R skill, so we've modified it to grant a significant shield when used. However, to prevent her from becoming too powerful, we've also reduced her health.




 Using Tachyon Field (R) now grants a 200 shield lasting for 2 seconds
 Maximum health reduced: 1000 → 900


Minor Changes


The following changes mainly focus on improving convenience and gameplay experience.



Ultimate Sound


 Separated voice lines for enemy and ally ultimates.
 Reduced the sound volume of ally ultimates.


Akira


 AutoFire applied to LMB: holding the button now auto-fires.
 Dimensional Slash (RMB2) can now be used while moving.
 Eased the just timing for the second attack of Soul Snatch (E2).
 Removed hit freeze from Third Eye (Shift).
 Flashbang (E1) modified to stop closer to the enemy.


Chloe


 Hey Buddy! Let's Play! (Shift2) modified for higher jumps.

Alice


 Increased the starting height of Blade Gust (RMB2): from 0 to 100.


Lucy

Bloody Claw(LMB2)

Scarlet Execution(Q)

Others


 Result screen omits the battle pass when it's maxed out.
 Added rapid-fire explanation to Sabio's Shift (Nitro Gliding) skill detail.
 Modified descriptions for Eveleen's Shift1 (Accretion Disc) and Shift2 (Exotic Matter).
 Added a square hitbox around Maximus for Shift1 (Ironblood Retribution).


Bug Fixes


 Fixed issue where Lucy's Lifesteal effect was applying multiple times.
 Corrected cylindrical hitboxes being wider than they appeared.
 Fixed Bernhard's Frenzied Dance (LMB) skill not triggering attack hitboxes.
 Al Manat's Cipher Hamattan (R1) skill effects no longer persist after stun.
 Addressed issue where using Dash skills on allies appeared to cause lag.
 Fixed Akira's skill attacks not gaining magic when blocked by Guard.
 Corrected Akira's Dimensional Slash (RMB2) not gaining magic if it hits the enemy late.
 Fixed Akira's Third Eye (Shift) counterattack not triggering.
 Changed Eveleen E2 (Hadron Wave) to not show targeting UI when selected.
 The issue where Chloe's character position appeared abnormal when her Shift2 (Hey Buddy! Let's Play!) was immediately canceled has been fixed.
 Addressed issue where Volf's R (Righteous Strike) AOE marker didn't disappear after death during use.
 Fixed Rei's RMB1 (Arctic Spike), RMB2 (Glacial Explosion) not triggering at specific timings.
 Corrected issue where canceling Al Manat's E2 (Talon of the Desert) applied cooldown.
 Fixed Lucy's LMB2 pre/post-delay resetting when E skill casting was canceled.
 Fixed Sabio Q applying Guardian Automata of Kukulkan for 12 seconds instead of 2 seconds on self.
 Resolved issue of falling below the Grave of Storms map upon death.
 Fixed problem of climbing over the boundaries in the Abandoned Temple of Velum map.


Additional fixes

 Improved issue where Eveleen's Accretion Disc (Shift1) and Exotic Matter (Shift2) skills could not attack targets in low positions
 Fixed issue where control points in the First Civilization Archives map were not being captured on sloped terrain
 Corrected issue where maintenance notification text exceeded the UI boundaries
 Improved issue where Akira's Empowered Flashbang skill had difficulty attacking enemies at higher positions when used on a hill
 Modified so that entering the training ground is not possible while in a party status
 Fixed issue where Lucy's Vermilion Hand (E) skill, when used vertically, had abnormal attack directions
 Corrected issue where the charging motion of Rei's Arctic Spike (RMB1) skill was displayed incorrectly
 Fixed issue where the Battle Pass description text box could not be scrolled when language was set to English
 Fixed issue where the cooldown for Maximus's Judgment (E) skill was not displayed


Thank you.

notes.title: Update plans after Early Access release
notes.content:
Intro
Hello, Storm Striker users, this is Alphakaman, the head of the Design Team.

It's already been two weeks since the release of Storm Striker.

Since the last hotfix, our development team has been fully focused on preparing the next patch.

I have revised our pre-launch plans to address the issues of Storm Striker as quickly as possible and to evolve the game into a better experience for you all. Today, I'll share those plans with you.

Update Plan
First off, here's our major update plan up until next February. It's not long-term, but I believe it's a plan that will solve the current major issues and expand the fun that the game offers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/d6ac3a2299213fece109f61df847656d859c11b0.png

Patch#1
This is the upcoming patch that I mentioned on Discord, originally scheduled for December 7th. However, as it includes more content than initially planned, unfortunately, the patch has been rescheduled to December 11th.

I ask for your understanding regarding this change in schedule.

Optimization
The development team was aware that the optimization was significantly lacking, and for this patch, we applied tasks that could be quickly implemented.

The development team recognizes the importance of optimization and will continue to work on improving it.

Expanded AE PASS
I thought now wasn't the right time to introduce monetization elements into the game, and since the addition of a season pass system is not in the immediate plans of my new update strategy, I felt that players needed some form of reward until then.

For that reason, we've dramatically expanded the Early Access Battle Pass by including items that were intended for future sale.

Below are the portraits of skins that you can additionally acquire in this expansion. (Please note that the actual color of the skins may differ from their portraits.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/9d3155e1252009b956160d881a031785ee300e09.png

Ladder Point System
The AE Pass expansion is a system for more casual players, while the LP system is designed for the more hardcore gamers. It's not exact, but we're adding LP that somewhat reflects MMR, allowing players to quantify their skills.

However, since it's not an official ranked game, we don't want players to feel pressured, so you'll only be able to see your own LP.

We ask for your understanding as the MMR will be reset in the December 11th patch to accommodate the addition of this system.

Chat System
We're aware that the in-game chat is currently quite limited, and it's one of the reasons the patch scheduled for the 7th has been pushed back to the 11th.

After the patch, you'll be able to chat in the lobby with your party and privately with friends through whispers.

While this isn't a complete implementation of chat, it's a significant improvement over what was available before.

Language Support
We hope that by supporting more languages, players from a variety of cultures can enjoy the game more comfortably. In addition to English and Korean, the list of languages we plan to support are as follows:

 Simplified Chinese
 Japanese
 Spanish
 German
 French
 Portuguese
 Russian


Patch#2
AI Opponent
We've noticed that many new players of Storm Striker are struggling to adapt to the game, leading to them dropping out.

Adding AI opponents is a feature intended to help these players ease into the game. Newcomers will initially play several games against AI characters, allowing them to acclimate to the game before playing with other users.

New Hero : Theo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/636c283344bd42e2f18b96ca3492bdb264d0f862.jpg
Theo is a ranged character with simple and intuitive controls, fitting for a shooter game. We anticipate that Theo will offer a distinct and enjoyable experience compared to other ranged characters.

Skill Change Extension (Primary)
One of the most positive and unexpected responses since the launch was to the swap skill system. Players found it more intriguing than I had anticipated, and I see great potential in it.

Naturally, it makes sense to further specialize and expand on a system that players enjoy.

Since you can't change characters mid-game in Storm Striker, we want each character to have more potential. This work, along with the trait system, should well integrate this intent into the game.

In Patch#2, as a start, we plan to overhaul underused swap skills and add a third swap skill to some characters.

For instance, Narae's E skill could change to a buff that increases allies' movement speed, and Maximus's E skill might become one that sets up a barrier upfront, making it easier to break through heavily contested corridors.

Key Binding
This is the Key Binding feature that many of you have inquired about.
As it is indeed a necessary feature, we are aiming to add it as soon as possible.

Patch#3
Talents System
The Talents system is designed to allow character building during gameplay in combination with swap skills. (However, it won't be in a way that creates a disparity in progress with the opponent.)

As I mentioned earlier in the **Skill Change Extension (Primary)**, it's an additional system intended to deepen the aspects of the game that players find interesting.

I will organize and share more detailed information about this system sometime next week.

New Hero : Electra
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/153bbcc4fbbc7750ae9b7d842a1ad2b27cfa9781.jpg
Electra is a healer with an explosive combination of healing and damage potential, featuring a resource system reminiscent of Bernhard's rage.

Initially designed to be a sub-healer similar to a damage dealer like Sabio, Electra has been modified to also serve as a main healer like Narae, depending on the swap skills used. This flexibility will be reflected in the upcoming release.

Shop & BattlePass
